_comment: Hook commands an older saltay-kokpit release registered and this one replaces. scripts/install.sh fills in __CLAUDE_HOME__ and removes them from ~/.claude/settings.json by exact command match before merging settings.hooks.json, so an upgrade never leaves both versions running. scripts/uninstall.sh removes these AND the current ones. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_v1.0.0: two UserPromptSubmit reminders (1.7 KB on every prompt) replaced by session-reminder.json in v1.1.0
_v1.1.0: unquoted paths (broke on a home folder with spaces) and inline hook commands replaced by quoted calls to hooks/*.sh in v1.2.0
PreToolUse: m=$(bash __CLAUDE_HOME__/hooks/hook-meta.sh); f=${m#*|}; if [[ -n "$f" && -f "$f" ]]; then mkdir -p .backups && cp "$f" ".backups/$(basename "$f").$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).bak"; fi
PostToolUse: m=$(bash __CLAUDE_HOME__/hooks/hook-meta.sh); f=${m#*|}; if [ -n "$f" ] && grep -qE '(password|secret|api_?key|access_?token|private_?key)\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]{8,}' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "⚠️  Possible hardcoded secret in $f" >&2; fi
